notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
The latest major update is now here! Try out all the new goodies:

New level: Fight through a crystal-spiked snowstorm to ascend the Rhyom Summit

New Fighter skills: Use Rage Strike to build up huge damage, or disarm foes with Stagger

New Ranger skills: Use Smoke Bomb to escape, or unload your ammo with Blast Away

New Caster spells: Star Magic (Starfire and Supernova) and Crystal Magic (Clarity and Crystallize)

New Cosmetics: Archon helmets are here, plus new “shifting” base metals

Video Recording: Click both thumbsticks and a camera will circle around to record your fight

notes.title: Miniboss Update
notes.content:
Minibosses have arrived! Face new enemies like the gleeful bomb-tossing Jester, the poison dagger-throwing Assassin, and the life-stealing Vampire.
Explore a new cavern world, Covenfel, featuring twisting underground passages full of luminescent crystals and dangerous enemies.
Try out randomly-offered Enhanced Skills: player upgrades with impressively boosted stats to enhance your build variety.
New unlockable Permanent Upgrades, as well as new Challenge features to reward experienced players.
Additional armor and helmet cosmetics, including the outfits worn by the new Miniboss enemies.
And more!
